comment: B4 composite state subject encoding round-trip vectors. Per spec/v1/zh/conformance/encoding.md §9.5: state_subject = base64url_nopad(sha256(canonical_json(components_array))). The pipe-separated form (`a|b|c`) is informational only; canonical wire form, signature input, state map index MUST use the hash form. components_array order is fixed per kind (§9.5.2). C18 (spec 2026-05-08): cx.flow.branch.* renamed to cx.flow.track.*; spec also dropped member/history_visibility/policy_components (Flow tracks no longer carry independent membership/visibility/policy — see Flow.discussion_realm_ref). Vectors retained as historical-shape examples to verify the encoding rule, which is kind-independent.

encoder.canonical_json: RFC 8785 / spec encoding.md §1: sorted object keys, no whitespace, exact JSON string representation

vectors.name: flow_track_member_bob_distinct_subject
vectors.comment: Same flow + track but a different actor — must hash to a distinct state_subject (collision negative).

vectors.name: flow_track_policy_components_same_subject_as_history_visibility
vectors.comment: Two different kinds share the same components_array shape; the state_subject is identical, but reducer keys still differ because slot key includes (space_id, kind) — confirms the subject hash is independent of kind.

vectors.name: device_revoked_same_subject_as_authorized_supersede
vectors.comment: device.authorized and device.revoked share a cell via component_slot_alias_of; their cell-subject hash is identical — revoke supersedes grant (cf. consent.grant/revoke + capability.grant/revoke patterns).

negative_vectors.name: wrong_component_order_collides_into_different_subject
negative_vectors.comment: If a buggy implementation reorders components_array (e.g. track before flow_id) it MUST produce a different hash from the canonical order — proving the order matters. Cotest computes the resulting hash and asserts it differs from the canonical flow_track_member_alice subject.

negative_vectors.name: pipe_form_must_not_be_used_as_canonical
negative_vectors.comment: The pipe-separated form is informational only. Cotest verifies that hashing the pipe string would not produce the canonical state_subject — implementations that use it would diverge.
